headline: Robust demand & pricing actions supports profitable growth

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : ACE reported healthy consolidated revenue growth of 18.9% YoY to ₹885.1 crore in Q2FY27 compared to ₹744.2 crore in Q2FY26.
Operating EBITDA increased 22.9% YoY to ₹133.9 crore from ₹109.0 crore, with operating EBITDA margin expanding 59 bps YoY to 15.1% from 14.6%, indicating improvement in operating profitability.
Consequently, PAT increased 82.4% YoY to ₹164.3 crore compared to ₹90.1 crore in Q2FY26.

Investment Rationale: • Strong domestic demand, market leadership, and healthy earnings growth to drive core business performance : ACE is well positioned to benefit from sustained government infrastructure spending, increasing mechanisation and recovery in construction activity.
valuation: Management targets initial revenue of approximately ₹150 crore in FY28, with medium-term revenue potential of ₹300–400 crore.

Rating and Target Price : We expect Revenue and PAT to grow at 16.7% and 20.3% CAGR respectively over FY26-FY28E & recommend BUY on ACE with a revised target price of ₹151 5 per share (based on 30 x FY28E EPS) Particulars ₹ (in crore) Market Capitalisation 13904 Total Debt (FY26) 0 Cash and Inv .
Medium-term revenue potential is estimated at ₹300–400 crore over the next 2.5–3 years. o Management is targeting approximately 15% operating EBITDA margin in the domestic business.
